title: The suite pins the sprint's lookup changes: a status-0 or no-result-list search held against a second source, the section fallback's next section, and kb_mcp's worktree redirect
goal: The existing pack_revalidate test (no new test id) plants a status-0 search and a 200 answer with no result list that a second source leans on and asserts both read as not checked, plants an edit to the section right after a fact with no cached previous text and asserts it is no longer kept by its section, and kb_mcp.session_script is driven on a planted linked worktree of a throwaway repository (the script's own checkout and a non-worktree directory return None); found by the SP-vdrsfftl review: BG-gx5b2yhu's and ST-gkrivybp's commits added no test and BG-vzsk2t5t's fixtures only moved edits out of the window.
